name: voice-rag-agent
description: Voice-to-voice support agent with RAG, semantic search and agentic tool calling (NestJS + Next.js)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('backend/.env')){fs.copyFileSync('backend/.env.example','backend/.env');console.log('Created backend/.env, add your LLM_API_KEY')}"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
